narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Each landmark is seven more than the last. One, seven, fourteen, twenty one.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Fourteen is only two bundles of seven, not seven bundles.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The next landmark needs seven of the last one, so we multiply by seven.
